Kafka Topic
✗ TIMEOUT / CRASH!
(Event Never Sent)

div.div:
The Catastrophic Split-Brain State:
• Local DB Committed: Customer credit was deducted and order is marked PAID.
• Broker Publish Failed: Network blip severed connection before event landed.
• Downstream Consequence: Warehouse never receives notification; goods are never shipped.
• No Rollback Possible: The DB transaction already completed before broker call failed.

div.div:
Transactional Outbox Guarantees:
• Atomic Ingress: Either both the order state and the outbox event commit, or neither does.
• Asynchronous Decoupling: CDC publisher operates independently of application thread pool.
• Zero Database Polling Overhead: WAL tailing imposes zero lock contention on business tables.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1268px; height: 1px; padding-top: 567px; margin-left: 30px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000; background-color: #FFFFFF;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; background-color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: The Invariant: Never attempt two-phase commits (2PC) or uncoordinated dual writes across database and message broker boundaries. Standardize on the Transactional Outbox Pattern backed by Change Data Capture (CDC) write-ahead log tailing.
